description: We are AgroAyuda, a team of five Information Systems and Computer Science Engineering students from Universidad Mariano Gálvez de Guatemala, Huehuetenango Campus. We joined the NASA Space Apps Challenge to explore how technology and NASA data can help address agricultural challenges. Inspired by the importance of agriculture in our region, we aim to learn, innovate, and collaborate to develop solutions that support more efficient, resilient, and sustainable farming.
